subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` account option, or folded into the existing `replyToMode` threading contract?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing config surface that overlaps existing reply-threading semantics and re-enables a previously suppressed Google Chat API path, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Fold into `replyToMode`
options.body: Use the existing threading configuration surface for the opt-in behavior and avoid a second Google Chat-only knob unless the platform needs one.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Keep the separate Google Chat option, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, tests, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave default DM thread suppression as-is until maintainers have broader Google Chat threading direction.

recommendation.title: Fold into `replyToMode`
recommendation.body: Use the existing threading configuration surface for the opt-in behavior and avoid a second Google Chat-only knob unless the platform needs one.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the prior DM-thread fix, verification, and recent Google Chat config/threading history.
